content.stem: 在反洗钱/打击恐怖主义融资(AML/CFT)合规工作中,实施可解释人工智能(AI)或机器学习(ML)技术以提高运营效率的主要优势有哪些？(选择两项.)

options.A: 能够在无需人工干预的情况下识别洗钱/恐怖融资风险
options.B: 减少对人力资源的需求
options.C: 更快、更准确地处理和分析大量数据集
options.D: 提高审计性、问责制和整体治理水平

content.stem_en: What are the main benefits of implementing explainable artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning (ML) technologies to improve operational effectiveness within AML/CFT compliance? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Identifies AML/CFT risks without the need for human involvement
options_en.B: Reduces the need for human resources
options_en.C: Processes and analyzes large datasets more quickly and accurately
options_en.D: Increases auditability, accountability, and overall good governance
